text:
maria_cto: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Quick follow-up: can we get clarity on SOC2 scope (prod vs staging), KMS BYOK timeline, VPC/private control plane rollout, and audit log retention? Putting an action list here so we can track. —maria

anna_security: TL;DR: SOC2 scope will include hosted API + Console by end of Q2; Dedicated/reserved capacity targeted for Q4. I'll post a scope & carve-outs doc later today.

devon_infra: For private control plane / VPC: pilot with 2 customers this month. Private deployment (air-gapped) package is on the roadmap, link in followup. Need product for onboarding checklist.

sam_product: Quick q — customers asking for BYOK with HSM. Are we shipping HSM support, or just customer-managed keys (software) initially?

anna_security: BYOK roadmap: Q3 = customer-managed keys (BYOK via cloud KMS + KEK support), Q4 = HSM/BYOK via partner HSM offering. We'll require integration tests + a key-rotation playbook.

ops-lead: Audit logs: hosted default retention = 90 days; enterprise add-on options = 1 year / 7 years. Logged fields: request metadata, model id/version, route, token usage metrics, but NOT raw customer prompt bodies (we redact sensitive fields by default). We'll put retention tiers in docs + pricing.

maria_cto: Action items (assign & deadline EOD next Wed): anna -> SOC2 scope doc + carve-outs; devon -> private pilot status + onboarding checklist; ops-lead -> audit retention tiers + runbook; sam -> collate customer HSM asks and priority signals. Please @me if you need more time.

devon_infra: noted. Also adding a console toggle for "private control plane" routing so teams can opt their org into private-only traffic.

alex_pm: I'll draft a SOC2 evidence request template we can hand to customers and auditors to speed up attestations.

security-bot: Reminder: SOC2 gap assessment meeting scheduled Thu 10:00am (zoom.link) :bell:

anna_security: FYI here's the lightweight KMS policy snippet we're proposing for BYOK customers (for discussion):

```
resource "redwood_kms_key" "customer" {
  rotation_period = "90d"
  allow_backup = false
  key_usage = "ENCRYPT_DECRYPT"
}
```

Needs infra review re rotation impact and backup story.

devon_infra: small infra note — 90d rotation may break long-running model KV caches / ongoing sessions. Recommend 180d OR support key versioning with transparent cache rewrap.

maria_cto: good catch. anna/devon sync and post final recommended rotation policy + compatibility notes.

sam_product: One more item: alerting on failed key decrypts — we should surface these in console logs + page on escalation. ops-lead, can you own runbook for decrypt failures?

ops-lead: Yep — will add an alerting rule, a traced error link in logs, and a short runbook. Will share live doc by EOD next Tue.

maria_cto: Thanks all — if anyone can't hit the EOD-next-Wed deadline, ping me. :thumbsup:
